status_code.description: HTTP status code for the request

instance_source.description: Source the instance was read from

api_key_source.description: Source the API key was read from

app_version.description: Version of the server-side GitGuardian application

token_scopes.description: List of scopes granted to the current authentication token

workspace_id.description: Identifier of the workspace the authentication token belongs to

token_storage.description: Where each instance's API token is stored (local, read-only diagnostic)

credential_store.description: State of the OS credential store

backend.description: Human-readable name of the credential-store backend

disabled.description: Whether the credential store is disabled via GGSHIELD_NO_KEYRING

reachable.description: Whether the credential store answered a read probe; null when disabled

status.description: Where the token lives and whether that is healthy

message.description: Human-readable explanation, null when not applicable

fix.description: Shell commands to fix the problem, null when none
